gen-dafont-dogica-gf-amiko: Wide, chunky and loud: Dogica spreads its heavy letters out with open curves, while Amiko, a modern sans-serif, keeps its terminals flaring outward. Give Amiko a modest size.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-bangla: Dogica's heavy, widely tracked letters are the first thing you notice, with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals. And Anek Bangla, a friendly sans with wide, barely curled s curves, handles the quieter running text.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-devanagari: Commanding from the first word, Dogica stretches its weighty letters wide. Anek Devanagari adds modern, open mouths and a tall middle zone, which is the pair's strongest card.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati is clean and approachable, its lowercase nearly rivaling the capitals. Dogica earns its place big and brief, where its heavy, widely tracked letters can command the space.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi reads clean and professional, with generous counters inside every small letter. Next to Dogica's heavy, wide display letters, its open-handed curves give the pair a strong push and pull.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-kannada: Dogica's lowercase climbs almost to the height of its capitals, then spreads out in wide tracking. Anek Kannada brings a contemporary, tall x-height, and that shared height is what ties them.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-latin: Dogica spaces its heavy letters unusually wide, leaving every curve visibly open at the end. Anek Latin follows with tall, plain sans lowercase held open, and that shared openness is their strongest tie.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads clean and contemporary, with little gap between lowercase and capitals. Dogica, heavy and widely tracked, makes it a stark partner, and the curves left open in both give the pair a shared habit.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-odia: Clean and contemporary, Anek Odia is the quiet half here, with rounds left unsealed. Over a long passage, Anek Odia stays easygoing under Dogica's heavy, widely tracked headings.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves, modern and easygoing. Anek Tamil sets those against Dogica's heavy, wide letters, and the open curve endings they share are the pair's strongest link.
